description: Get prioritized action items ranked by value at risk. 6 item types emitted: benefit_expiring, at_risk_this_period (pattern-backed leakage signal — Phase 8 D), unused_prior_period, fee_renewal (with recommended_action, retention_leverage, historical_offers), negative_roi, welcome_offer_at_risk. Filter via action_types — accepts both category names (expiring, renewal_approaching) and specific response-type names (benefit_expiring, at_risk_this_period, fee_renewal) for precise filtering. e.g. action_types=['at_risk_this_period'] returns ONLY pattern-backed alerts; action_types=['expiring'] returns both benefit_expiring AND at_risk_this_period.

action_types.description: Types to include. Default: all 6. Category names (expiring, renewal_approaching) expand to all their response types; response-type names filter to exactly that type.

name: get_action_items
